description: arXiv:2609.27336v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Automated red teaming often replays a fixed set of prompts, which measures known risks but cannot learn from failures found during testing. We present CART (Closed-Loop Adaptive Red Teaming), a framework that uses each result to guide what it tests next.
